panels.title: NVIDIA FY2026 Revenue Increase Summary

sources.title: “Compute & Networking revenue increased 67% year-over-year driven by accelerated computing and AI, Data Center demand for Blackwell platform, and strong networking growth.”
“Blackwell architecture launched in FY2025, Rubin platform introduced in FY2026 targeting agentic AI workflows, supporting future growth.”
“A $4.5 billion charge related to excess inventory and purchase obligations impacted the Compute & Networking segment operating income in early FY2026.”
